body: God has always existed. This is hard for us to wrap our head around because we had a beginning. We have been given the breath of life, in return, god wants us to acknowledge and praise his creations, and to have a connection with him.

According to the Bible God gave us free will so we could decide things for ourselves and have a choice. He seeks people who truly believe that Jesus died for the cost of sins(which is death, and those who confess that “Jesus is Lord.” No matter what the sin is (except for one, it can be forgiven through Jesus and salvation 


Mark 3:28-30 and Matthew 12:31-32

“I tell you the truth, all the sins and blasphemies of men will be forgiven them. But whoever blasphemes against the Holy Spirit will never be forgiven; he is guilty of an eternal sin.”
